sources.title: gpt-oss-20b Model by OpenAI | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: The gpt-oss-20b is designed as a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, structurally identical to the larger 117B variant, albeit with different hyperparameters. This model leverages SwiGLU activations and incorporates learned attention sinks within its architecture.
